data.long_meaning: In Latin, Gustin translates to 'Staff of the Gods'. This name was given to children born under the sign of Jupiter, the Roman god of the sky and thunder. The name Gustin carries the meaning “Staff of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gustin usually hope their child will grow to embody staff of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
